bar-chart-view.description: Vertical or horizontal bars, grouped, stacked or 100%, with a reference line, value labels, tooltip, empty state and data table.

examples.note: Switch layouts and select bars in the log below.
examples.keyboardNote: Bars are keyboard-focusable: Tab to a bar, arrows to move, Enter to select.

horizontal.note: Horizontal bars truncate long labels and grow taller with more categories.

values.note: With showValues, each bar prints its formatted value next to the tip; labels follow valueFormat and stay hidden while bars morph between layouts.

diverging.note: Negative values grow below the baseline, with labels under the bar; positives and negatives share one scale around zero.

empty.note: With no plottable data, the chart hides the SVG and renders a localized empty message instead of empty axes.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone bar chart component.

props.note: Inputs, possible values and defaults. The pointSelect output emits the selected category.

bar-chart-view.title: Bar chart
